ambiguities.text: The specification says wallets 'MUST sanitize each RPC url' but does not define what sanitization entails.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume sanitization includes: URL format validation, protocol check (https required), blocking private/local IP ranges, and preventing URL injection attacks.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define what happens if rpcUrls are provided but fail validation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the request should be rejected with an appropriate error code if provided RPC URLs cannot be validated.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'switching chains' is ambiguous about whether this changes the default chain or only the active session chain.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this changes the active chain for the current dApp session, not the wallet's persistent default.

implicit_assumptions.description: The user can accurately evaluate whether a chain switch request is legitimate.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may approve malicious chain switches leading to asset theft on fake/malicious chains.

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet has access to a reliable list of default chain configurations for common chains.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Phishing attacks impersonating mainnet or popular chains may succeed without warning.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot intercept or modify the RPC validation requests (net_version, eth_chainId).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Man-in-the-middle attacks could make malicious RPC endpoints appear legitimate.
